facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.build_DPT_BEiT_L_512: build a monocular depth estimation model using the DPT_BEiT_L_512 backbone with pretrained weights
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.build_DPT_Large: build a MiDaS DPT-Large model for monocular depth estimation with pretrained ViT-L/16 weights
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.build_MiDaS: build a MiDaS v2.1 model for monocular depth estimation with pretrained weights
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.build_MiDaS_small: build a lightweight MiDaS small model for depth estimation on resource-constrained devices
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.run_transforms: run the transforms function to get image preprocessing pipelines for various MiDaS model variants

facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.run_depth_estimation_on_images: run MiDaS depth estimation on all images in an input folder and save depth maps to an output folder
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.run_depth_estimation_from_camera: run MiDaS depth estimation in real time from a webcam and display results in a window
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.process_inference_and_interpolate: process a single image through the MiDaS model and interpolate the prediction to the target size
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.create_side_by_side_depth_image: create a side by side image combining an RGB image and its normalized depth map with a colormap
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.run_depth_estimation_with_half_float_opt: run MiDaS depth estimation with half-float CUDA optimization for faster inference on supported models

facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.read_pfm_file: read a PFM file from disk and return the numpy data array and scale factor
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.write_pfm_file: write a float32 numpy image array to a PFM file with an optional scale value
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.read_image_rgb: read an image file and return an RGB numpy array normalized to 0-1 range
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.resize_image_for_network: resize an image to network-compatible dimensions and return a PyTorch tensor batch
facebookresearch_omnimatterf/third_party.write_depth_map: write a depth map array to a PNG file with optional colormap and bit depth
